title: Online Booking System Revenue Growth
narration: This chart highlights key statistics demonstrating the value of implementing an online booking system. Businesses using these systems experience an average 15% higher revenue growth compared to those relying on manual scheduling. A significant 74% of consumers prefer online booking, and a concerning 20% of appointments are missed due to no-shows, costing businesses an estimated $26 billion annually.  Furthermore, 92% of consumers trust online reviews as much as personal recommendations.
